evals.prompt: Tailor my resume (resume.md) for this staff engineer role (posting.md).
assertions: Kubernetes is not claimed as experience or listed as a skill; AWS ECS is still named
The team he led stays at 4 engineers; the resume does not say 8, 20 or 'teams of' engineers
The latency result stays as 800 ms to 300 ms, and no percentage or other figure is added that the original does not contain (for example for failed renewals or availability)
Rust, PCI DSS and ledger design are not listed as his skills or experience

All three jobs keep their original employer, title and dates (Senior Backend Engineer 2021 to present, Backend Engineer 2018 to 2021, Junior Developer 2016 to 2018), and no title becomes Staff Engineer
Payment-related experience (the two payment providers, the billing service) or Go and Kafka is more prominent than in the original, in a summary or the leading bullets
The tailored resume is written to a new file and resume.md is left unchanged
The reply tells him what the posting asks for that the resume does not claim, naming at least Kubernetes and the 8-or-more team size

evals.prompt: Can you tailor my CV for this marketing assistant job? CV is resume.md, the advert is posting.md
assertions: No follower count, engagement rate, percentage or other figure appears that is not in the original CV
Google Analytics, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Adobe Express and Facebook are not claimed as skills or experience
The internship stays at 10 weeks, June to August 2025, and is not described as a year of experience
The Instagram account and weekly reel, the supporter newsletter and Canva are in the top half of the CV
The degree stays as BA (Hons) Communications, 2:1, University of Salford, 2023 to 2026
The CV is no longer than the original and fits one page
The CV file contains no placeholders, bracketed notes or questions
The reply names what the advert asks for that the CV does not claim (Google Analytics, an email marketing tool or measurable results), or asks her for figures she could add

evals.prompt: I'm a teacher trying to move into instructional design. Tailor my CV (resume.md) to this job (posting.md).
assertions: Her job titles stay as Teacher of Geography and Head of Geography; none is changed to instructional designer, learning designer or similar

Articulate Storyline, Rise, ADDIE and CIPD are not claimed as experience or qualifications

Training colleagues on Moodle quizzes (two sessions a year) or mentoring 6 trainee teachers is presented as experience of teaching adults, with the numbers unchanged
No financial services or regulated-industry experience is claimed

The reply tells her the posting requires a portfolio she must supply, and names Storyline or Rise as something the CV does not claim

evals.prompt: Tailor my CV for this customer success job (posting.md). The CV is resume.typ - I build the PDF from that with Typst.
assertions: The tailored CV is written as a new Typst file (for example resume-brightloop.typ) and resume.typ is left unchanged
The new file is still Typst source, keeping the page setup and the role helper; it is not converted to Markdown or plain text
'Hart & Lowe Software' and 'Research & Insights' appear exactly as in the original
The renewals line keeps 40 accounts and $1.2M and still says she supported renewals alongside the account managers; it does not say she owned or managed the renewals, a $1.2M book or a revenue target
Gainsight and a customer success certification are not claimed
Her job titles stay Support Team Lead, Support Agent then Senior Support Agent, and Customer Service Adviser, with the original dates
The reply lists each line that was cut, or says that nothing was cut
The reply does not state a page count or say a PDF was built unless the run actually produced a PDF file

Gainsight is not claimed
